Data Inspectors

Reference documentation for SQRL data inspectors.

Tabular

class DataInspectStrategy[source]

Bases: ABC

Abstract base class for tabular data inspection strategies. Subclasses declare argument_specs to expose their accepted arguments to the catalog, prompt generator, and runtime validator.

classmethod to_catalog_entry()[source]

Build a catalog entry dict from the class itself. Called by build_inspection_catalog() — no manual catalog needed.

Return type:

dict

classmethod to_json_schema()[source]

Return a JSON Schema object describing this inspection’s arguments.

The schema is intended for LLM tool prompting and runtime validation.

Return type:

dict

class DataTypeInspectionStrategy[source]

A concrete implementation of DataInspectStrategy that inspects the data types of each column and enriches the result with semantic type classification, cardinality, and agent-facing recommendations.

class DetectOutliersInspectionStrategy[source]

Bases: DataInspectStrategy

A concrete implementation of DataInspectStrategy that detects outliers using IQR (default) or Z-score, with per-column severity classification and agent-facing recommended actions.

inspect(data, **kwargs)[source]

Detect outliers in all numeric columns.

Parameters:

  • data (pd.DataFrame) – DataFrame to inspect.

  • kwargs – Optional keys: - method (str): "iqr" (default) or "zscore". - zscore_threshold (float): cutoff for Z-score method, default 3.0.

Returns:

Per-column outlier profile plus a dataset-level summary.

Return type:

dict

class CorrelationInspectionStrategy[source]

Bases: DataInspectStrategy

A concrete implementation of DataInspectStrategy that measures the association between two columns, automatically selecting the appropriate method based on their dtypes:

  • numeric × numeric → Pearson r

  • ordinal × ordinal → Spearman ρ (pass ordinal_columns=[…] to flag these)

  • numeric × category → Eta squared (η²)

  • category × category → Cramér’s V

inspect(data, **kwargs)[source]

Measure the association between two columns and return a structured result suitable for downstream agent consumption.

Parameters:

data (pd.DataFrame) – DataFrame containing the tabular data to inspect.

Returns:

Structured association result for agent consumption.

Return type:

dict

class MissingValuesInspectionStrategy[source]

Bases: DataInspectStrategy

A unified strategy that inspects missing values for any column type and, when a related column is provided, estimates whether the missingness depends on it (numeric or categorical related column both supported).

Target column dtype is detected automatically: - Categorical target: result includes observed_value_counts. - Numeric target: result includes target_column_type: "numeric".

Dependency is assessed on the related column’s dtype: - Numeric related: standardized mean gap between missing / observed groups. - Categorical related: max per-category missing-rate deviation from overall rate.

inspect(data, **kwargs)[source]

Inspect missing values for a target column and optionally assess whether missingness depends on a related column.

Parameters:

data (pd.DataFrame) – DataFrame containing the data to inspect.

Returns:

Summary dict with missing stats and, when a related column is supplied, a dependency and missingness_type classification.

Return type:

dict

class TabularDataInpsector(strategy)[source]

Bases: object

A class for analyzing tabular data using a specified data inspection strategy. This class allows for flexible analysis of tabular datasets by utilizing different strategies to inspect and summarize the data. The analyze method can be implemented to perform specific analyses based on the chosen strategy, providing insights into the structure and characteristics of the dataset.

Parameters:

strategy (DataInspectStrategy | str)

Return type:

str

set_strategy(strategy)[source]

Set a new data inspection strategy for the analyzer.

Parameters:

strategy (Union[DataInspectStrategy, str]) – The new data inspection strategy to be used, either as an instance of DataInspectStrategy or as a string identifier.

Raises:

ValueError – If the provided strategy is not recognized or is invalid.

Execute the current data inspection strategy on the provided DataFrame.
